data.why: streamlit_app.py falls back to examples/waste/project.yaml automatically when no projects/ folder or FIELDDASH_CONFIG is set, so the bundled anonymized household waste-survey JSON data loads with no extra setup or credentials.

goals: get an overview of how many survey responses came in, where collection sites are, and how submissions trended over time
cross-tabulate one survey question against another (e.g. waste destination by neighborhood) to spot patterns
filter the dataset by neighborhood, age, gender, or income and see how the summary and charts update
inspect the underlying form schema to find a question's stable reference id before writing a new project config
export the filtered data table to CSV or Excel for further analysis
browse the curated highlight charts configured for this survey

review.summary: This is a faithful, well-evidenced tree of a schema-driven field-survey dashboard: its phases follow real stages from checking how collection went through filtering and export, and the screens I opened back the claims, including the 7-row filtered CSV. It needs small fixes before filing: an unmentioned active filter in the box-plot evidence, a mismatched search-step action, a missing refresh-for-live-data task, and splitting the combined highlights/custom-page feature.
